name: dsh-pc-pilot
description: PC-Pilot - lightweight Windows + Chromium computer-use runtime, CLI, and DeepSeek Harness host plugin.

scripts.build:wgc: dotnet publish native/wgc-capture/wgc-capture.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o lib/wgc
scripts.test: node scripts/build-helper.mjs --check && node test/split-text.check.mjs && node test/native-fixes.check.mjs && node test/package-contents.check.mjs && node test/wgc-server-lifecycle.check.mjs && node test/ipc-payload.check.mjs && node test/round4-hardening.check.mjs && node test/features.check.mjs && node test/parity.check.mjs && node test/cua-actions.check.mjs && node test/postcondition.check.mjs && node test/app-identity.check.mjs && node test/batch-observation.check.mjs && node test/image-history.check.mjs && node test/element-cache.check.mjs && node test/cursor-render.check.mjs && node test/codex-parity.check.mjs && node test/fix-validation.check.mjs && node test/delegated-launch.check.mjs && node test/close-window-verification.check.mjs && node test/oneshot-stdin.check.mjs && node test/snapshot-contract.check.mjs && node test/process-reliability.check.mjs && node test/background-target.check.mjs && node test/browser-session.check.mjs && node test/browser-statusbar.check.mjs && node test/headless-launch.check.mjs && node test/statusbar.check.mjs && node test/pc-pilot-skill.check.mjs && node test/cli.check.mjs && node test/browser-provider.check.mjs && node test/latency.check.mjs

dshhub.summary: Windows computer-use：标准动作、顺序批处理、UIA 无障碍定位、绑定状态的 PNG 观察、后台合成输入、遮挡免疫的按窗口截屏与点击，必要时使用真实 SendInput；运行期间屏幕上方显示状态提示条。
